record.notes: In force from its publication in the Boletín Oficial on 2 Jun 2023 (Article 3). Annex I is addressed to members of the national public sector who lead AI projects, develop technologies, adopt technologies developed by others or draft the technical specifications for acquiring them; Annex II is a graphic scheme of the stages of AI projects. Argentina's official legal database lists Resolución 111/2024 of the Ministry of Justice (Boletín Oficial, 11 Apr 2024), which creates the National Comprehensive Programme on Artificial Intelligence in Justice, as a norm that complements or modifies the Disposición; no repeal is listed. A separate AAIP resolution of August 2023 created a programme on transparency and personal-data protection in AI use (AR-02).

verification.note: Recheck of 18 Oct 2026. Stored and read: the original text of Disposición 2/2023 with Annex I on Argentina's official legal database (argentina.gob.ar, copy of 11 Oct 2026), which gives the number DI-2023-2-APN-SSTI#JGM, the issuing sub-secretariat, the signature (01/06/2023), the publication in the Boletín Oficial (02/06/2023, no. 35182, p. 67), Articles 1-4 and the annex; the Boletín Oficial notice of 2 Jun 2023 (boletinoficial.gob.ar, copy of 11 Oct 2026), with the same text and publication date; and the database's list of norms that complement or modify the Disposición (argentina.gob.ar, copy of 17 Oct 2026), which lists only Resolución 111/2024 of the Ministry of Justice, creating a national programme on AI in justice. The list gives that resolution's title, not its text, so how it relates to the Recommendations is not stated. The Boletín Oficial could not be reached on 17 Oct 2026, so its copy of 11 Oct 2026 is used. Version 1's notes said the database shows no amendment, and that the issuing sub-secretariat was reorganised after December 2023; the first is contradicted by that list and the second rests on no stored file, so both were removed. No English translation by an Argentine public body was found; law-firm summaries in English are not translations.

judgment.status_reasoning: Article 3 makes the Disposición effective from its publication in the Boletín Oficial, which took place on 2 Jun 2023 (no. 35182, p. 67). It approves recommendations ('Recomendaciones'), and Annex I calls itself a manual offering theoretical and practical tools to the public sector, so it is non-binding guidance. The database's list of norms that complement or modify it (copy of 17 Oct 2026) holds only Resolución 111/2024 of the Ministry of Justice, which creates a programme on AI in justice; nothing stored shows the Recommendations repealed, withdrawn or replaced. 'Published (non-binding, current)' stands.
judgment.date_reasoning: date_published 2023-06-01 is the signature ('Sanción: 01-06-2023'; 'Ciudad de Buenos Aires, 01/06/2023'); date_in_force 2023-06-02 is the publication in the Boletín Oficial, from which Article 3 makes it effective.
judgment.scope_reasoning: Government guidelines on trustworthy AI for AI projects of the national public sector; in scope with no note.
